description: Email-send write-lock classifier corpus: the Target prod incident plus 100 differentiated likely-failure cases (50 false-positive risks that must NOT lock, 50 false-negative risks that MUST lock). Labels are newline-joined click signals exactly as the click gate collects them (visible text, then attribute values such as id/name/role). Production code must NOT embed these labels as an allow/deny list.
